error_codes.message: Select one canonical device before running diagnostics or recovery.
More than one matching device exists; choose a canonical device.
The selected canonical device was not found in the caller scope.
The request device does not match the tenant/user/canonical device barrier.
Route generation does not match device generation; relink or regenerate safely.
The selected route is currently unreachable.
Privileged recovery requires fresh Local Manager authorization.
Caller is not allowed to perform privileged recovery for this device.
This diagnostic requires admin break-glass scope.
Tenant path cannot fallback to admin break-glass diagnostics.
Recovery was accepted but verification readback is still pending.
Recovered status cannot be declared without same-cycle readback.
Heartbeat evidence is stale for this route/device generation.
Heartbeat signature is invalid or expired.
Bounded probe timed out.
Diagnostics were redacted to prevent secret exposure.
Too many reachability or recovery attempts.
Request validation failed.
Idempotency key conflicts with a different request body.
A required internal dependency is unavailable.

invariants: Every response MUST include secrets_included=false when the field exists.
No diagnostic response may include plaintext tokens, connector secrets, signed installer URLs, or raw machine identifiers.
Tenant requests MUST NOT call or fallback to connector.mad4b.com.
State-changing recovery MUST require tenant_id + user_id + canonical_device_id authority.
Recovered status MUST NOT be emitted until same-cycle readback is complete.
